connect_matrix_bot: connect the Matrix bot to a homeserver with access token authentication and optional E2EE
disconnect_matrix_bot: disconnect the Matrix bot from the homeserver and stop the sync loop
send_matrix_message: send a text message to a Matrix room with optional reply, threading, and markdown formatting
send_matrix_image: download an image from a URL and upload it to a Matrix room as a media message
send_matrix_document: upload a local file as a document message to a Matrix room
send_matrix_voice: upload an audio file as a native voice message to a Matrix room
edit_matrix_message: edit an existing Matrix message using the m.replace relation
redact_matrix_message: redact (delete) a message or event from a Matrix room
create_matrix_room: create a new Matrix room with optional name, topic, invites, and preset type
set_matrix_presence: set the Matrix bot presence status to online, offline, or unavailable
